import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    a = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
    best = 0
    for mask in range(1 << n):
        last = -10
        total = 0
        ok = True
        for i in range(n):
            if (mask >> i) & 1:
                if i - last < 3:
                    ok = False
                    break
                last = i
                total += a[i]
        if ok and total > best:
            best = total
    print(best)


main()
